headline: Is Hormel Foods (HRL) Cheap Following John Ghingo's CEO Appointment?
summary: Hormel Foods (HRL) is back in focus after the board confirmed president John Ghingo will become chief executive officer in October 2026. headline: Has Hormel Foods (HRL) Fallen Far Enough To Stop Looking Expensive?
summary: Hormel Foods stock has fallen about 34.5% over the past five years, yet its Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate currently suggests the shares trade at a sizeable discount, while traditional earnings based multiples point the other way and screen the stock as expensive. The share price decline of about 34.5% over five years means long term holders have seen a meaningful erosion in capital value. headline: Hormel names its new CEO
summary: Jul. 28—AUSTIN, Minn. — Hormel Foods Corp., a southern Minnesota Fortune 500 company known as the maker of Spam, announced a new leader to replace the interim CEO of the past year. Hormel's Board of Directors have appointed John Ghingo as president and chief executive officer. His tenure will start on Oct. 26.
